title: Starfish Prime / Bluegill Triple Prime EMP
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Starfish Prime / Bluegill Triple Prime EMP, about 1962 at Pacific nuclear test range, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Bluegill Triple Prime was four years before where we incidentally created an EMP in the Starfish Prime series.

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels talks about Starfish Prime and Bluegill Triple Prime, American nuclear tests set off high above the Pacific in 1962. He says that in the Starfish Prime series the US accidentally created an EMP, an electromagnetic pulse, a burst of energy that can knock out electronics. He raises it in a debate with a skeptic, tying these tests to the wider story of unexplained events around nuclear weapons.
